cases.text: The harbor opens early. Small fishing boats cross the water while workers unload baskets beside the old stone pier.
To plant a bean, place it in damp soil near a sunny window. Water gently and watch for the first green leaves.
The museum has a blue door and a wide staircase. Inside, visitors can explore paintings, maps, and models of ancient ships.
A bicycle bell helps warn people on a shared path. Slow down near corners and leave enough space when passing.
The train leaves from platform seven. Keep your ticket nearby and check the destination before stepping into the carriage.
On a clear evening, the moon can appear above the eastern hills. Its bright surface reflects sunlight toward the Earth.

baseline: Fresh settled six-second baseline, at most three attempts after five-second settling; same frozen v2 rule, no threshold changes.
noise_policy: Check separate preflight quiet before stimulus, and first/last two seconds of main capture; retain every attempt. Only measured room-noise failures permit two retries, appended after pending cells. Acquisition failures are neutral for the streak and grant no retake. Three consecutive distinct noisy cells auto-pause and restore. No performance retakes.
trace_policy: Enable arrival trace. Drain immediately after each reply window BEFORE any PCM or WiFi export; also drain once at eight seconds and before each capture to bound the ring. Save metadata around every drain. Export-era overwrites are not represented as reply-window coverage.
wifi_precondition: Build CONFIG_DG_WIFI_OBSERVE=y and require wifi_observation.dump available:true before first reply; abort/restore if unavailable.
observers: rtp_evidence authenticated, UDP, downlink (health required; cap 200000)
live admission: zero admission_budget delta, received == dispatched at each quiescent endpoint
scoring_anchor: first non-silent successful transport write (20 ms mean-square >1024); BotStarted remains diagnostic only
stop_policy: Offsets from first non-silent successful transport write; absent anchor means stop_not_played failure. Retain in-guard loss and recognition/interruption, including wholly suppressed utterances. Use actual 48 kHz invocation/duration witness and conservative clock/sample bounds, no listening or fitted-delay scoring.
pass_rule: Six clean two-sentence replies, alternating volumes 0/-6, cold first included. Zero proposed/accepted false turns; exactly one onset per clean reply at rearm_ms=2000; report all deviations, no performance retries. All step-2 resources and live admission checks required.
guard_basis: Step-3 twelve clean 15 dB speech cells: largest startup residuals commonly at 200..400 ms, outliers extend later. Select 400 ms source interval; 64 ms fixed AFE delay plus block quantization and conservative DMA/read bounds extend actual closure beyond nominal 464..484 ms. Not a guarantee against all residual echo; test live false turns.
metrics_decision: No device-bound RTVI metrics; server metrics remain enabled.
cleanup: flock for all board/Jabra operations; restore/hash verify normal 9936da45, mixer byte-equal, stop owned bot, release lock; retain lock if restoration fails
witness_checks: Connect/Ready/post-Ready minimum internal heap versus 83840 B
Whole-session zero RTVI metrics, received==dispatched, admission_budget delta0, reply-start burst count/types over first 100ms
Exactly one onset and closure per reply; rearm_ms=2000; report MIC3 onset lead interval and flag any possible lead >100ms; expected lead 0..50ms and closure600..660ms reported, not assumed
Zero proposed/accepted false turns; AFE residual in first400ms after each unguarded MIC3 re-onset following >=500ms quiet (fixed1024sample delay)
Gap from previous accepted non-silent last_end estimate to next onset; historical export-separated sample, not spontaneous conversation
notes: Step5b witness, exploratory short hold. No Stop stimulus, no clock tightening. Frozen v2 gate unchanged. All original failures retained; no performance retakes.
